top_findings.title: Live server never initializes the books table (schema created on a discarded connection)
top_findings.evidence: src/main.rs:79 serves rusqlite::Connection::open_in_memory() with no DDL; src/main.rs:80 models::create_connection("in-memory").ok() creates the books table on a separate on-disk file connection that is immediately dropped. Confirmed by the stray on-disk SQLite file 'in-memory' whose .tables shows books. Every DB route fails at runtime with 'no such table: books'. Tests pass (test_coverage=1.0) only because they build their own schema-initialized connection. Exact regression FEEDBACK.md said to fix; not fixed.
top_findings.suggestion: Apply models::TABLE_DEF to the served connection in main() (or use models::create_connection with a real path) and remove the discarded create_connection("in-memory").ok() call.
